TripRoom.title: TripRoom
TripRoom.description: Shared collaborative travel planning room synchronized in real time across companions.

roomId.description: 6-character uppercase invite code acting directly as the exact document ID.

ownerId.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the room creator.

ownerName.description: Display nickname of the room creator.

status.description: Lifecycle state; once archived, mutations are locked.

lastUpdatedBy.description: UID of the collaborator who committed the latest state update.

lastUpdatedByName.description: Nickname of the collaborator who committed the latest state update.

tripPayload.description: Structured native Map representation of TripState (setup, intel, packing, budget, expenses, timeline, wishlist, crew, meetup).

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the room was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest update, enforcing write rate-limit cooldown.

RoomMember.title: RoomMember
RoomMember.description: Authorized collaborator record under a TripRoom, mapping a verified user UID to a claimed companion seat without storing PII.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the collaborator.

seatId.description: Claimed crew seat identifier inside TripState.crew.

displayName.description: Non-PII traveler nickname displayed in the trip.

role.description: Travel role description (e.g., 摄影探店, 行程主理).

joinedAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the member joined.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when seat assignment was last updated.

UserRateLimit.title: UserRateLimit
UserRateLimit.description: Per-user room creation quota and server-timestamp cooldown tracker to prevent malicious room spamming.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

roomCount.description: Total rooms created by this user (capped at 20).

lastRoomCreatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the user's most recent room creation (10s minimum interval).

JoinedRoomRef.title: JoinedRoomRef
JoinedRoomRef.description: Lightweight per-user bookmark of rooms created or joined, queried strictly with limit(5).

routeTitle.description: Cached route title for quick display.

seatId.description: Claimed seat ID in that room.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when last accessed or updated.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when admin privilege was provisioned.

RedeemCode.title: RedeemCode
RedeemCode.description: Single-use 1-year or lifetime Trip Kit Pro authorization code issued by the admin for WhatsApp/Facebook community members.

code.description: 14-character formatted activation code matching document ID.

planType.description: Membership tier unlocked by this code.

durationDays.description: Number of Pro days granted (365 for annual, 36500 for lifetime).

note.description: Optional non-PII admin memo (e.g., WhatsApp 粉丝渠道).

createdBy.description: Immutable UID of the issuing admin.

redeemedBy.description: Empty string when unused; bound to redeemer UID upon activation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of generation or redemption.

UserEntitlement.title: UserEntitlement
UserEntitlement.description: Per-user Pro membership entitlement atomically bound to a redeemed single-use code.

uid.description: Owner UID of this Pro entitlement.

redeemedCode.description: Exact redeem code burned in the same atomic batch.

activatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the code was redeemed.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest entitlement activation.

PhotobookOrder.title: PhotobookOrder
PhotobookOrder.description: Non-PII print-on-demand travel photobook order specification and production status.

orderId.description: 14-character formatted print order ID matching document ID.

uid.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the ordering traveler.

bindingSpec.description: Cover and paper stock binding specification.

photoCount.description: Number of curated photos included in the book.

currencyCode.description: ISO currency code of order pricing.

trackingNumber.description: Courier tracking code populated by admin upon shipment.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when order was placed.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest status update.

PhotobookOrderShipping.title: PhotobookOrderShipping
PhotobookOrderShipping.description: Isolated PII recipient shipping address under a PhotobookOrder (strictly owner/admin single-doc access, list disabled).

uid.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the ordering traveler.

recipientName.description: Recipient full name for courier delivery.

customerNote.description: Optional gift message or print instruction.

/rooms/{roomId}.description: Primary collaborative trip state documents keyed by 6-char invite code (single-doc get/onSnapshot only; collection list disabled).

/rooms/{roomId}/members/{memberUid}.description: Per-room collaborator authorization records enabling Master Gate write checks and instant membership revocation.

/rateLimits/{userId}.description: Atomic per-user room creation rate-limit ledger enforcing 10s cooldown and max 20 created rooms.

/users/{userId}/joinedRooms/{roomId}.description: Private per-user index of recently joined rooms, queried with limit(5).

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Read-only admin registry document (writes locked; bootstrapped with verified owner email).

/redeemCodes/{codeId}.description: Single-use 1-year and lifetime Pro authorization codes issued by admin and atomically burned upon redemption.

/users/{userId}/entitlements/{entitlemen.description: Per-user Pro membership record ('pro') atomically verified against a newly redeemed code.

/photobookOrders/{orderId}.description: Non-PII print-on-demand photobook orders restricted to owner and verified admin.

/photobookOrders/{orderId}/shipping/{shi.description: Split-collection PII recipient shipping address ('recipient') restricted strictly to order owner and verified admin with list disabled.
